summary: Divine Savior Academy argues for maintaining current E‑Rate eligibility, continued dark‑fiber support, a flexible discount matrix, and school‑controlled screen‑time limits while emphasizing privacy‑focused network filtering. Divine Savior Academy urges the FCC to preserve core E‑Rate functions, maintain special construction eligibility, keep CIPA requirements practical, avoid blanket screen‑time limits, and prevent cost allocation that harms Head Start/Pre‑K programs.
